name: workspaces
title: Workspaces
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Track folders, Git repositories and worktrees, each with its own tabs.
description: Keeps a workspace folder list and reads Git/worktree state. Each workspace and worktree has its own tabs (its own layout, started in its folder); switching makes them the shown tabs, creating them with a shell the first time. Removing a workspace removes its tabs, never its running programs. The sidebar consumes its published workspace data. Turn it off to stop scanning and remove these commands; layouts, folders, worktrees and running shells are not deleted.

works_with.without: A workspace opened for the first time cannot start its shell
Open shell here can't add a tab to a workspace that already has tabs
